375
RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Thursday, the December 8, 2005/Agrahayana 17, 1927 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Prime Minister; Agro and Rural Industries; Atomic Energy; Coal;
Communications and Information Technology; External Affairs; Labour and
Employment; Ocean Development; Overseas Indian Affairs; Personnel, Public
Grievances and Pensions; Planning; Science and Technology; Shipping, Road
Transport and Highways; Small Scale Industries; Space; Statistics and
Programme Implementation; Youth Affairs and Sports)
Total number of questions —155
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Generation of employment
Opportunities
1647. SHRI T.T.V. DHINAKARAN:
Will the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that 25 lakh
additional employment opportunities are
to be generated during the Tenth Five Year
Plan period;
(b) if so, the target achieved so far,
year-wise; and
(c) whether any survey has been done
to know if this employment generation
has checked migration of rural labour to
cities?
Losses to KVI
†1648. SHRIMATI KUM KUM RAI:
Will the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Khadi and Village Industry
are running at a loss;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c) the measures taken to prevent this
loss?
Bank loans under REGP
1649. SHRI MATILAL SARKAR: Will
the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that many of the
village artisans cannot set up village
industries by bank-loans under REGP
schemes, because they cannot provide
security required for that loan;
(b) whether it is also a fact that the real
spirit of Khadi schemes is lost to a great
extent for this reason;
(c) whether Government propose to
introduce the system of grants in creating
entrepreneurship in village industries;
(d) if so, the time-frame thereof; and
(e) if not, the alternative thereof?

376
Loans lying with State KVIBs
1650. SHRI MATILAL SARKAR: Will
the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) the total amount of loans lying with
the State Khadi and Village Industries
Boards from the Central Khadi and Village
Industries Commission, State-wise;
(b) the names of the projects that
benefit the rural people where financial
assistances are transmitted through State
Khadi and Village Industries Boards;
and
(c) the number of these projects that
are actually in operation and how many
have already ceased to run, State-wise?
Electricity power houses using
atomic energy
1651. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI: Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) the total number of electricity power
houses where electricity is generated
through the use of atomic energy,
State-wise;
(b) whether there is some proposal
under active consideration of Government
to set up more such power stations in the
country;
(c) if so, the details of such power
stations to be set up in Uttar Pradesh and
if not, the reasons therefor; and
(d) whether at the time of setting up
such power stations, leaking of atomic
electricity till "Chechnya" (in the then
USSR) shall be checked properly?
Fund to accomplish Coal Vision-2025
1652. SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY:
SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there is a
need for Rs.2,84,692 crores to accomplish
Coal Vision 2025;
(b) if so, the main activities Government
propose to under-take to achieve the goal;
(c) whether it is also a fact that an
additional Rs. 95,000 crores is required to
carry out the open cast mining activities to
increase production from the present
300 mt. to 902 mt. by 2025; and
(d) if so, in what manner Government
are planning to pool the resources?
Mining of coal
1653. SHRI B.K. HARIPRASAD: Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether India has more than
1,60,000 million tonnes of coal reserves
that cannot be mined;
(b) whether India proposes to tap this
unrecoverable coal reserve through
underground coal gasification process
which is already in operation at Australia's
Chichilla Project;
(c) whether India has the requisite
technical expertise to build coal gasification
plants; and
(d) if not, whether India is scouting for
overseas technology/expertise for such
projects?

377
Supply of coal to Kothagudem Power
Project
1654. SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA: Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether any request from the
Government of Andhra Pradesh has been
received for supply of coal to the proposed
Kothagudem Thermal Power Project
State-VI;
(b) if so, when;
(c) whether SCCL is going to open cast
mines at Sattupally in Khamman District
of Andhra Pradesh;
(d) if so, whether Government would
instruct SCCL to supply coal to
Kothagudem Thermal Power Project; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Specifications for coal mines
